دُمْلُوجٌ (S, Mgh, K) and ↓ دُمْلُجٌ (S, K) and ↓ دُمْلَجٌ (K) An armlet; a bracelet for the arm; syn. مِعْضَدٌ; (S, Mgh, K;) i. e. the ornament thus called: (Mgh, TA:) pl. of the first دَمَالِيجُ; (S;) [and of the second and third دَمَالِجُ.] You say, أَلْقَى عَلَى دَمَالِيجَهُ [He put (lit. cast) upon me his armlets]. (S.) ―
-b2- Also the first and ↓ second A smooth stone. (TA.) ―
-b3- And [the pl.] دَمَالِيجُ Hard lands: (K:) so in the L and the Tekmileh. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
